Sortenorganisation of Appenzell that markets Appenzeller cheese under colour labels.

b.d: Hard Gouda-type cheese brand from milk of the Beemster polder, with hand-stirred curd and ripening in changing conditions.
Wisconsin cheese maker founded by Errico Auricchio, of the Neapolitan Auricchio family.
Benedictine abbey at Urt in the Pyrénées-Atlantiques whose monks support themselves chiefly by making Abbaye de Belloc ewe's-milk cheese.
El Segundo, California maker of pea-protein meat alternatives, founded by Ethan Brown.
South Korean food and drink company in Seoul whose Banana Flavored Milk has been sold since 1974.
London kefir brand founded by Natasha Bowes, making kefir drinks, kefir yoghurts and kids' kefir.
Sacramento almond growers' cooperative, maker of Almond Breeze almond milk.
Jean-Yves Bordier's Saint-Malo butter house, known for hand-kneaded and flavoured butters.
French brand of Gournay-style herbed fresh cheese created by François Boursin of Normandy; owned by Groupe Bel since 2007.
Vermont dairy cooperative owned by Agri-Mark, known for cheddar.
Californian plant-based beverage maker founded by Greg Steltenpohl; started in almond milk, then oat and coconut.
Dubai camel dairy brand of Emirates Industry for Camel Milk & Products, selling fresh, long-life and powdered camel milk.
Arla Foods cheese brand covering soft-ripened, blue, semi-hard and cream cheeses.
British cheddar brand made by Saputo Dairy UK in Cornwall, named after Wells Cathedral.
One of Brazil's most popular brands of requeijão cremoso, developed by Italian immigrant Mario Silvestrini in Minas Gerais.
Tofu brand sold in UK supermarkets, with extra-firm and grillable marinated tofu.
Hunts Court Farm, Dymock, cheesemakers who revived Single Gloucester and make Stinking Bishop from Old Gloucester milk.
American strained-yoghurt maker founded by Hamdi Ulukaya, top-selling US Greek yoghurt brand.
Upton Cross, Cornwall, maker of Cornish Blue.
Goat-cheese maker in Arcata, California, known for Humboldt Fog; Midnight Moon is made for it in Holland.
French food group that began with Isaac Carasso's yoghurt in Barcelona in 1919.
Camel milk seller offering frozen camel milk, camel milk powder and camel milk ghee online.
Ioannina dairy using Epirus milk, calling itself the first exported feta brand.
Swiss milk processor headquartered in Lucerne with plants in Europe and the Americas.
Greek producer of Original Feta PDO from sheep's and goat's milk.
Humphrey Errington's dairy at Ogcastle near Carnwath, Lanarkshire, making Lanark Blue from its own ewes.
Greek dairy company (Filippou Brothers) that made the first commercial strained yoghurt.
Dutch dairy cooperative formed by the merger of Friesland Foods and Campina, based in Amersfoort.
Cheese dairy at Brochon, Côte-d'Or, maker of Époisses and of L'Ami du Chambertin, created by Raymond Gaugry in 1950.
Ferguson family farm at Schull, County Cork, making Gubbeen cheese from its own mixed herd.
Derbyshire creamery at Pikehall that originated Dovedale and was licensed to make Stilton in 2014.
Higashiōsaka food company whose House Foods America is the largest tofu supplier in the United States.
Skyr brand made with heirloom Icelandic cultures in partnership with an Icelandic farmer-owned dairy.
Redwood City, California maker of heme-based meat alternatives, founded by Patrick O. Brown.
Isigny-sur-Mer cooperative making PDO butter and cream, Mimolette and Camembert.
Family cheesemaker near Fethard, County Tipperary, making Cashel Blue and the ewe's-milk Crozier Blue.
Artisan cheesemaker in Greensboro, Vermont, run by Andy and Mateo Kehler, with the Cellars at Jasper Hill ageing for others.
Cheese cooperative at Laguiole, the only producer licensed to make Laguiole PDO cheese; also known for Aubrac aligot.
Keen family cheddar made at Moorhayes Farm, Wincanton, for five generations.
Irish butter and cheese brand of Ornua, the export cooperative of Irish dairy co-ops.
Kirkham family making raw-milk Lancashire at Beesley Farm, Goosnargh.
Coconut-based dairy-free drink brand owned by First Grade International Ltd.
Greek cheesemaker and a leading exporter of Feta PDO.
Allgäu cheese company (Hofmeister-Champignon) that patented Cambozola and has made it since 1983.
French dairy group headquartered in Laval, founded by André Besnier; owner of Parmalat, Galbani, Leerdammer and, since 2025, Fonterra's consumer brands such as Anchor.
Minnesota dairy cooperative, one of the largest US butter and cheese producers.
Trademarked Dutch Swiss-type cheese made in Schoonrewoerd, Dalfsen and France; Bel brand handed to Lactalis in 2021.
Maker of Sparkenhoe raw-milk Red Leicester at Sparkenhoe Farm, Upton.
Illinois kefir maker founded by Michael Smolyansky, with kefir as its flagship product.
British vegetarian food brand created by Linda McCartney; owned by Hain Celestial since 2006.
Danish butter brand of Arla Foods.
Cornish dairy at Ponsanooth led by Catherine Mead, maker of Cornish Kern.
Franche-Comté affineur that has aged Comté at the 1870s Fort Saint-Antoine since 1965.
Japanese food holding company whose dairy arm makes Meiji Bulgaria Yogurt.
Chinese dairy and ice-cream maker headquartered in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia; a leading milk producer in mainland China.
Macedonian milk industry based in Koufalia, Thessaloniki; yoghurt, desserts and cheese including feta.
London coffee-and-oat-milk brand set up by Stuart Forsyth, Jonathan Chiu and Will Rixon, best known for barista oat.
Iceland's largest dairy company, owned by two farmer cooperatives, and main maker of skyr.
Montgomery family farm at North and South Cadbury, Somerset, making raw-milk clothbound cheddar.

b.d: US meatless frozen-food brand of Kellanova, owned by Kellogg from 1999.
Bavarian family dairy group, a leading UK yoghurt brand.
London retailer, wholesaler and affineur of British and Irish farmhouse cheese founded by Nicholas Saunders and Randolph Hodgson.
Northern Swedish dairy formed by merging three dairy associations; sole producer of Västerbotten cheese.

Norwegian dairy company and Tine's only domestic challenger in cheese; launched brown cheese in 1997.
Freiburg tofu maker of plain and smoked tofu, tofu fillets and tofu sausages.

Hood River, Oregon company founded by Seth Tibbott as Turtle Island Foods; owned by Morinaga Nutritional Foods since 2023.
Brothers Todd and Maugan Trethowan, makers of Gorwydd Caerphilly and Pitchfork Cheddar, in Somerset since 2014.
Dairy farm and artisan cheesemaker in Dodgeville, Wisconsin, known for Pleasant Ridge Reserve.
Finnish dairy company founded by 17 co-operative dairies, owned by dairy cooperatives.
Sonoma, California, maker of hand-made Dry Monterey Jack.
Websterville, Vermont, cheese and butter maker founded by Allison Hooper and Bob Reese.
